name: InputTags
summary: Enter and manage a list of free-form tags with keyboard chip navigation.

useWhen: Collecting several typed values that stay visible as removable chips
Applying rules to typed values, such as no duplicates, a limit, or a validator
avoidWhen: Choosing from predefined options; use TagSelect
Plain text tokens edited in place without rules; use TokenField

obligations: Enter adds a validated tag; Backspace or ArrowLeft transfers focus to the last tag.
Delete removes a focused tag and restores input focus when the list empties.
Stable tag IDs preserve controlled duplicate-value reconciliation.

behavior: Enter adds the trimmed draft as a tag, if it passes validation, and empties the input.
Enter never submits a surrounding form.
Backspace or ArrowLeft in an empty input moves focus to the last tag.
A draft is rejected when it is blank, repeats an existing tag exactly, would exceed maxTags, or fails validate.
The duplicate check is case-sensitive, and allowDuplicates turns it off.
validate receives the trimmed draft and returns whether to accept it; it runs after the blank, duplicate, and limit checks.
A rejected draft stays in the input, no callback is called, and invalid and errorMessage do not change.
An added tag calls onChange with the full string array and then onTagAdded with the new tag.
A removed tag calls onChange with the full string array and then onTagRemoved with the removed tag.
Delete removes a focused tag and restores input focus when the list empties.
Stable tag IDs preserve controlled duplicate-value reconciliation.
The committed tags are the value; the text being typed is a separate draft that joins the value only when Enter adds it.
The draft input has no name and the tags have no hidden inputs, so a surrounding form does not submit them.
required adds an asterisk to the label and sets aria-required on the field; it does not check that the list has a tag.
errorMessage is shown only while invalid is true, in place of the description.
